description: Something the issuer saw that no other kind describes, under a topic it names. A topic is a short fixed word, never free text; what was seen is behind the content references.

about.description: A stable identity written as a URI. Syntax is not authentication.

items.description: An exact reference to content, a record or a Core event.

details.description: Issuer-defined detail: up to 64 named scalars. Nothing in it is interpreted by the base kinds, and nothing in it is content; content goes behind a reference.
